name: 24354 · Marion, VA
findings: ZIP 24354 (Marion) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 24354 (Marion) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 24354 (Marion) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.
